caption:
Some things AI just can't do, and this might be the best proof yet.

The 'AI could never' series has taken over the internet, with people showing off skills no AI can copy. This one nails it: pure physical instinct, creative camera work, and split-second timing no computer can fake. AI keeps getting smarter every week, but the gap between 'intelligent' and 'human' has never been more obvious.
